facts.fact: Vanguard reports the NDPC National Commissioner saying the Nigeria Data Protection Act, enacted in June 2023, mandates the Commission to decide the adequacy of other countries' data protection as a basis for cross-border transfer of personal data, and that the Commission approves binding corporate rules, codes and certification mechanisms for such transfers.
